title: A Compositional Theory of Curvature in Probabilistic Circuits
abstract: arXiv:2608.12869v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) are generative models that support exact inference and, unlike deep neural networks, admit an exact and tractable measure of loss-surface curvature: the trace of the Hessian of the log-likelihood. Recent work regularizes this trace globally to bias learning toward flatter, better generalizing optima. We show that treating sharpness as a global regularizer can be misspecified for PCs, whose curvature is inherently compositional. We prove that each sum node's contribution to the Hessian trace factorizes exactly into its circuit flow, which measures how heavily the node is used, and a local sharpness term determined by its output distribution. This decomposition provides insights into why global sharpness regularization is depth biased and can lead to underfitting. Building on it, we introduce an adaptive sharpness aware regularizer that penalizes nodes based on intrinsic local curvature and preserves closed f

translated_title: 概率电路曲率的组合理论
translated_abstract: 概率电路（PCs）是支持精确推断的生成模型，与深度神经网络不同，它们允许对损失曲面曲率进行精确且可处理的度量：即对数似然Hessian矩阵的迹。近期工作全局地正则化这一迹，以促使学习向更平坦、泛化性更好的最优解偏移。我们表明，将锐度视为全局正则化器对于PCs可能是错误设定的，因为其曲率本质上是组合性的。我们证明每个求和节点对Hessian迹的贡献可以精确分解为其电路流（衡量节点使用频率）和由其输出分布决定的局部锐度项。这种分解揭示了全局锐度正则化为何存在深度偏差并可能导致欠拟合。基于此，我们引入一种自适应锐度感知正则化器，它根据内在局部曲率惩罚节点，并保持闭式解。
tldr: 本文提出概率电路曲率的组合分解理论，证明全局锐度正则化存在深度偏差，并据此设计了一种自适应锐度感知正则化器以改善泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a compositional decomposition theory of curvature in probabilistic circuits, showing global sharpness regularization is depth-biased, and introduces an adaptive sharpness-aware regularizer to improve generalization.
